name: Anwen Grym
source:
I met Anwen the first time [url=/c146901]Cerys[/url] invited me to the Grym manor. An earnest teen, Anwen quickly latched onto me and became my second friend among [url=/c146899]Cymhen[/url]'s granddaughters. She is one of only a few of Cymhen's daughters or granddaughters without the Affinity, and as such, tends to be competitive with her cousins, especially Cerys.
